title: The Rift Storm
text: The Gate is weeping light. A storm has come out of it raining glass and lightning, carrying the smell of the far side, and one by one the roofs are going. The city needs timber for the roofs and iron for lightning rods before the storm learns the streets.

temptation.label: Send your servants out to gather the fallen glass.
temptation.text: Rift glass sells for its weight in gold to the wrong people. Some of the servants come home.

triumph.text: The rods catch the lightning; the roofs hold. When the storm ends the Gate is dark and quiet, as if it has spent itself for a while.

holds.text: The worst of it is kept off. For a month the glass in the gutters hums.

falters.text: The storm takes the roofs of the poor quarter, along with one House's best building. The people beneath are found standing upright with glassy eyes. They do not lie down again.

calamity.text: The storm stays a season. Every House loses someone to the glass. When it ends, the Gate is a little wider.
